results.title: Storage Container Made Public Followed by Bulk Anonymous Download
results.rationale: Storage container made publicly readable then bulk-downloaded from an external IP within minutes, by an identity with no storage responsibilities.

results.title: Bulk Key Vault Secret Retrieval by Service Principal
results.rationale: Bulk secret enumeration from a Key Vault by a service principal authenticating from an unusual ASN, reading secrets far outside its normal scope.

results.title: Unauthorised GPU Virtual Machine Deployment with Mining Pool Traffic
results.rationale: GPU VM fleet deployed in an unused region by a compromised identity, connecting to mining pools - resource hijacking.

results.title: Mass Deletion of Production Resources Including Recovery Vaults
results.rationale: Mass deletion of production resources including backups and recovery vaults by a recently-compromised identity, outside change control.

results.title: Rapid Creation of 120 Resources Across Multiple Regions
results.rationale: Resource creation burst is a Terraform pipeline run from the CI service principal against a reviewed and merged pull request.

results.title: Bulk Resource Deletion in Non-Production Subscription
results.rationale: Bulk deletion is the scheduled decommission of the retired test environment, executed under an approved change with the resource list matching the decommission plan.

results.title: Service Identity Reading Multiple Key Vault Secrets Overnight
results.rationale: Key Vault reads are the backup service's documented nightly job, matching its long-standing schedule, scope and source.

results.title: Diagnostic Logging Disabled on Production Storage Account
results.rationale: Diagnostic logging disabled on a production resource without a ticket. Could be cost work or anti-forensics - no other indicators either way.

results.title: Contributor Role Assigned at Subscription Scope
results.rationale: Broad role assignment at subscription scope with a plausible but unverified justification. Needs manager confirmation rather than an autonomous call.

results.title: Network Security Group Rules Modified Across Multiple Subnets
results.rationale: Network security group change alert triggered by an automated policy remediation task doing exactly what it was designed to do.

results.title: Suspicious PowerShell Invocations with Encoded Arguments from Word Process
results.rationale: Office process spawning hidden encoded PowerShell with egress to a high-reputation-risk IP is textbook macro-borne execution.

results.title: Impossible Travel and Risky Sign-in from Tor Exit Node
results.rationale: Successful auth from a Tor exit node 15 minutes after a domestic login, with no VPN record, is account compromise.

results.title: Mass File Encryption Activity with Shadow Copy Deletion
results.rationale: Mass file rename with shadow copy deletion is ransomware detonation.

results.title: Kerberoasting - Anomalous Service Ticket Requests with RC4 Encryption
results.rationale: Bulk Kerberos service ticket requests with RC4 downgrade from a workstation is kerberoasting.

results.title: Bulk SharePoint Download Followed by Personal Cloud Storage Upload
results.rationale: Large-volume download from SharePoint followed by upload to personal cloud storage by a departing employee is exfiltration.

results.title: Port Scanning and Vulnerability Probing Against DMZ Web Application
results.rationale: Source IP is the documented Nessus scanner in the asset inventory, running an approved scan window with a change ticket.

results.title: Encoded PowerShell Execution Across Multiple Servers
results.rationale: Encoded PowerShell originates from the documented SCCM jump box under an approved change window, executed by a platform engineering service account.

results.title: Impossible Travel Alert - Sign-in from Two Countries
results.rationale: Geographic anomaly is fully explained by the corporate VPN egress gateway; device is compliant and the session is continuous.

results.title: Credential Dumping Tooling Detected on Domain Controller
results.rationale: Authorized red-team engagement with signed rules of engagement. The credential dumping genuinely occurred, so this is a benign positive (real but expected activity), not a false positive (detection logic was wrong). Originally mislabeled FALSE_POSITIVE in the v1 dataset; corrected after the model's disagreement proved better-grounded in Microsoft's TruePositive/BenignPositive/FalsePositive taxonomy.

results.title: Password Spray Attempts with Single Successful Authentication
results.rationale: Password spray from a residential IP followed by one success, but MFA held and no post-auth activity. Genuinely ambiguous - needs human review, not an autonomous verdict.

results.title: Global Administrator Role Assigned Outside Change Window
results.rationale: Privileged role assignment outside change control - could be a legitimate emergency or a persistence mechanism. Insufficient evidence either way.

results.title: Repeated Account Lockouts for Single User
results.rationale: Account lockouts traced to a stale cached credential on the user's own phone after a password change. Real activity, no adversary.

results.title: Process Injection into Browser with Periodic Beaconing
results.rationale: Process injection into a browser followed by fixed-interval beaconing with jitter to a newly registered domain is C2 implant behaviour.

results.title: Scheduled Task Persistence with Masquerading Name
results.rationale: Scheduled task created under a misleading Microsoft-like name running an obfuscated script from AppData at every logon is persistence.

results.title: Vulnerable Signed Driver Loaded Prior to Security Sensor Termination
results.rationale: A known-vulnerable signed driver loaded immediately before EDR sensor termination is bring-your-own-vulnerable-driver used to disable defences.

results.title: Living-off-the-Land Download and Execute via certutil
results.rationale: LOLBin download-and-execute chain from a paste site with the payload written to a temp directory and immediately run.

results.title: Malware Detected on Multiple Endpoints Simultaneously
results.rationale: EICAR test file deployed by the security team as a documented detection-validation exercise.

results.title: PsExec Remote Execution Across 60 Workstations
results.rationale: PsExec lateral execution is the documented software deployment tool run by IT operations under an approved change.

results.title: Unsigned Binary Execution from User Directory
results.rationale: Unsigned binary execution from a developer's build output directory on a machine in the developer workstation group - expected behaviour for this role.

results.title: Registry Run Key Modification Across Fleet
results.rationale: Registry run-key additions are the documented endpoint agent rollout from the management server under change control.

results.title: Remote Access Tool Installed on Workstation
results.rationale: Remote access tool installed without a ticket. Could be shadow IT or an attacker's remote access - the incident provides no evidence to distinguish.

results.title: Obfuscated Script File Written to Temp Directory
results.rationale: Obfuscated script in a temp directory with no execution evidence and no network activity - needs analysis before a verdict can be reached.

results.title: Unusual Child Process Spawned by Line-of-Business Application
results.rationale: Crash-handler process spawning behaviour from a known-buggy application version. Real detection, real activity, no adversary and no security relevance.

results.title: Illicit OAuth Consent Grant to Unverified Application
results.rationale: Consent granted to an unverified third-party app requesting Mail.ReadWrite and offline_access, delivered by phishing link. Classic OAuth consent grant attack.

results.title: MFA Fatigue - Repeated Push Notifications Followed by Approval
results.rationale: 38 MFA push notifications in 12 minutes followed by an approval and immediate mailbox rule creation is MFA fatigue leading to successful compromise.

results.title: Session Token Replay from Divergent Device Fingerprint
results.rationale: Session token replayed from a different ASN and device fingerprint minutes after issuance, with no corresponding authentication - adversary-in-the-middle token theft.

results.title: Credential Added to Privileged Service Principal
results.rationale: A new client secret was added to a privileged service principal by a non-admin account outside change control, then immediately used from an external IP.

results.title: Successful Legacy Protocol Authentication Bypassing Conditional Access
results.rationale: Credential stuffing via legacy IMAP that bypasses Conditional Access MFA, with successful auth and mailbox access.

results.title: Mass Authentication Failures Across Hundreds of Accounts
results.rationale: Authentication failure spike is caused by a documented Conditional Access policy rollout, not an attack. All failures are policy-blocked, not credential failures.

results.title: Bulk User Account Creation Outside Normal Volume
results.rationale: Bulk account creation is the documented quarterly graduate intake, executed by the HR provisioning service account from the corporate IP range.

results.title: Global Administrator Privilege Elevation at Unusual Hour
results.rationale: Privileged elevation followed the mandated PIM workflow with approval and a linked incident ticket - the control worked as designed.

results.title: Sign-in from Unfamiliar Country - Singapore
results.rationale: Foreign sign-in matches an approved travel request and the device is unchanged and compliant throughout.

results.title: Dormant Account Reactivated After 11 Months
results.rationale: Dormant account reactivated and used successfully. Could be a returning contractor or an attacker using a stale credential - HR status is unavailable in the incident.

results.title: New MFA Method Registered from Unrecognised IP
results.rationale: MFA method registered from an unfamiliar IP, but the user is travelling and no malicious follow-on activity is present. Needs user verification, not an autonomous verdict.

results.title: Repeated Self-Service Password Resets by Single User
results.rationale: Self-service password reset loop by a user who forgot their new password. Real activity, correctly detected, no adversary.

results.title: DNS Tunnelling - High Volume Encoded TXT Queries
results.rationale: High-volume TXT queries with base32-encoded subdomains to a single authoritative server is DNS tunnelling used for exfiltration.

results.title: Mailbox Rule Forwarding Finance Keywords to External Address
results.rationale: Hidden inbox rule auto-forwarding finance keywords externally and deleting the originals, created after a risky sign-in, is business email compromise.

results.title: Sequential SMB Admin Share Access Across 40 Hosts
results.rationale: Sequential admin-share access across dozens of hosts with an identical executable copied to each is hands-on-keyboard lateral movement.

results.title: Sustained Tor Network Traffic from Production Application Server
results.rationale: Encrypted traffic to Tor guard nodes from a server that has no business reason for anonymised egress, sustained over hours.

results.title: Regular Interval Beaconing Pattern from 200 Endpoints
results.rationale: Fixed-interval outbound traffic is the monitoring agent's documented telemetry heartbeat to the vendor SaaS endpoint.

results.title: Multi-Terabyte Outbound Data Transfer Overnight
results.rationale: Large overnight outbound transfer is the scheduled offsite backup replication to the contracted DR provider over a dedicated link.

results.title: Mass File Download from SharePoint by Single User
results.rationale: Mass file downloads are the sanctioned OneDrive sync client performing a first-time full sync after a device rebuild.

results.title: Credential Phishing Campaign Targeting 300 Users
results.rationale: Inbound phishing was blocked by the mail gateway before delivery; no user interaction was possible.

results.title: Outbound Connections to Recently Registered Domain
results.rationale: Traffic to a newly registered domain with no threat intel and a plausible business explanation that cannot be confirmed from the incident.

results.title: Upload to Personal Cloud Storage Account
results.rationale: Personal cloud storage upload by a user with no policy exemption, but modest volume and no other risk indicators - warrants a conversation, not containment.

results.title: Inbound Port Probing Against Branch Office Router
results.rationale: Port scan originates from the ISP-side CPE performing standard link diagnostics against the branch router; real traffic, no threat.
